title: Nether Legion Mod
description: This mod adds several items, an interesting mechanic, and a real goal: to create the most powerful weapon: the Legendary Mace!
body:
This mod adds a very complex mechanic to the game, as well as 1 new block, 11 new items, and a bunch of new mechanics!
So, to craft all stages of the mace, you'll need a new block (an improved blacksmithing table, crafted from 4 diamonds and 4 emeralds. To create it, simply place the blacksmithing table, 4 diamonds, and 4 emeralds on the blacksmithing table (if that doesn't work, try using blocks!)), onto which you'll need to place a new upgrade template, which has a low chance of dropping from the Ominous Vault (you'll need 9 of them), 2 blocks of the netherite, 2 heavy cores, 2 nether stars, 1 totem of undyingness, 2 maces, and 1 elytra. To craft all stages, drop items in this order:
1. Regular Mace + Block of Netherite + New Template —>
2. Resulting Mace + Totem of Undying + New Template —>
3. Resulting Mace + Block of the Netherite + New Template —>
4. Resulting Mace + Heavy Cannonball + New Template —>
5. Resulting Mace + Regular Mace + New Template —>
6. Resulting Mace + Nether Star + New Template —>
7. Resulting Mace + Elytra + New Template —>
8. Resulting Mace + Nether Star + New Template.

To craft a Spear, you will need 1 Iron Block and 2 Sticks. These ingredients can be simply dropped into a crafting table. To craft a Legendary Spear, you will need: Spear + 2 Diamonds + 2 Tridents + Prismarine Shard + 2 Emeralds + Blaze Rod. Simply drop these items on our new block, and you'll receive a new item.
Now let's move on to the new features.

For the Legendary Mace: Right Mouse Button + Left Shift = throw upward, Right Mouse Button = dash forward. Totem of Undying activates if the player has low XP, and if not used, it simply disappears after 10 minutes. The "levitation" function is activated by running + Right Alt. Also, only one mace can be crafted per server. Passive effects: Speed ​​2, regeneration. For the Legendary Spear: Running + Right Mouse Button = throw like a trident, only with built-in loyalty. Left Mouse Button = strike. Left Mouse Button + Left Shift = pierce. Right Mouse Button = dash forward. The cooldown for both is 2 seconds. Enjoy the game!
